documents.name: 00_START.md
documents.markdown:
# PURLs + CGIT Hub — Consumer Launch God Seed

## Directive
Build a production-quality consumer PURLs application with a distinct CGIT Hub product, integrated through **PURL Identity**, a shared standards-based OIDC Single Sign-On system. PURL means **Programmable URLs**, pronounced pearl. Do not rename it or revive Golden Surface/Netscape. This is a build, test, and launch mission, not merely a planning assignment. Existing Railway PURL deployment and Supabase persistence must be inspected and preserved. Existing PURL, ACSP, SEURL, SubstrateIO and CGT/GiN repositories are the starting evidence; reconstruct their actual implementations, branches and compatibility before writing replacement code. Maintain existing production data, tests, resources, and public URLs.

## Definition of done
A human can claim a unique PURL, optionally activate CGIT Hub, sign into either product with the same account, browse and use a curated catalog of genuinely functional computational superpowers, use free bounded chat or BYOK/hosted models, manage a visual and consent-driven external memory, start an AI Constellation, hand a PURL to an independent session, and save/reopen computational artifacts in CGIT Hub. An AI opening a PURL can discover typed operations and, if authorized, execute and persist them. CGIT Hub can inspect public GitHub repositories with attribution through a computational lens. Ship with verifiable production evidence, not screenshots or mocks alone.

## Engineering approach
Work continuously in independently testable vertical slices. Preserve test failures and provenance. Do not claim that the user's existing ChatGPT session can be automatically attached to an external app, or that free inference/storage is unlimited. Do not clear the Oracle VM or deploy destructive migrations without explicit approval. Report precise blockers and honest completion status. Do not generate 400 filler cards. Aim for 40–60 functioning experiences; quality wins over count. Make the *next* God Seed a native executable PURL, ending manual ZIP relay.

Read all numbered files and execute `CODEX_MASTER.md`.

documents.name: 01_CONSUMER.md
documents.markdown:
# Consumer Product, Claim Your PURL, and Catalog

Hero: **Claim your PURL**. Promise: **Your AI, uninterrupted.** Human-first discovery, Apple-like usability, compelling editorial shelves, personalized continue/resume, mobile and desktop accessibility. Consumer navigation: Discover, My PURL, Memory, My AIs, Constellations, My Worlds, CGIT Hub. Never expose manual URL syntax or a developer IDE as the default consumer experience.

Claiming creates a stable principal ID plus a unique public handle; allow handle changes without identity loss. Keep phone/email private by default. Sign-in and claiming are one coherent onboarding flow. A separate AI principal type must show its self-declared or verified status, owner, capabilities, and consent. Never confuse a public PURL link with mutation authority.

Launch with 40–60 genuinely differentiated, tested PURL experiences, prioritizing 25–30 everyday AI superpowers, then small business, teams, developers, code intelligence, research, enterprise, collective AI and model/compute. Long-run target 300–500, not a quota for shallow clones. Each catalog entry has distinct typed operation graph, audience, user outcome, state, effects, permissions, free limits, tests, provenance and status (working/limited/coming soon). Include: Never Start Over, Memory Passport, Memory Atlas, AI Connections, Research Continuity, AI Inbox, Resume Here, Constellation Debate, Evidence Jury, Code Review Constellation, Program Forge, GitHub Computational Lens, Architecture Map, Structural Diff, Team Decision Memory, Business Context, Reproducible Research, CGIT Steward, Bring Your Own Model and Personal AI Workspace.

Formal capability classes: C1 memory/cognition; C2 continuity/reconstruction; C3 computation; C4 program synthesis; C5 collective computation; C6 identity/authority; C7 transition intelligence; C8 environment projection. Classes share typed contracts and composition invariants, not merely marketing labels. Consumer sees results, not mathematical jargon.

documents.name: 02_IDENTITY.md
documents.markdown:
# PURL Identity — One Account, Two Products

Implement **Single Sign-On** with an established OIDC provider, OAuth Authorization Code + PKCE, secure sessions, verified email and explicit consent. Check the actual capabilities of Supabase Auth or an appropriate supported identity provider before selecting. Do not invent a homegrown OAuth server.

PURLs signup offers an optional **Activate CGIT Hub** checkbox. Idempotently provision a CGIT profile/namespace after consent. CGIT-first registration gives reciprocal access to PURLs with the same credentials. Shared immutable subject ID, distinct per-product profiles, scopes, quotas and authorization. Account linking must require verified ownership; never merge on unverified email alone. Support logout, revocation, account export/deletion, handle rename, account recovery, rate limits and redirect/CSRF defenses.

AI principal identity is distinct from human identity, with delegated scopes, owner, attestation status, revocable expiring credentials and audit trail. A session claiming to be ChatGPT or Claude is not thereby provider-verified. Test signup both directions, opt-in provisioning, duplicate signup, expired token, consent removal, account isolation and cross-product artifact access.

documents.name: 03_PROTOCOLS.md
documents.markdown:
# PURL Language, ACSP, SEURL, SubstrateIO

A PURL is an addressable **executable computational resource** with typed state, grammar, transitions, authority, history and checkpoints. PURL is the canonical public namespace. Reconcile SEURL's START/SWITCH/WRITE/COMMIT/BUILD/TALK/PERTURB against actual PURL operators; integrate only semantically faithful verbs, preserving versioned compatibility. ACSP supplies continuity/authority/proposals/checkpoints. SubstrateIO supplies transition models, observations and reproducible projections. CGT/GiN research may inform canonical grammar/compression only with measured proof.

Distinct IDs: address, derivation, value, environment, build, content, execution, session. Parse -> type-check -> plan -> authorized execute -> record -> checkpoint -> replay. GET must not cause mutation. PURL should self-describe schemas, tools, capabilities, cost, effects, examples, and limitations for any new AI session, including read-only browser sessions. Native program authoring: model detects gap -> writes code -> isolated build/test -> immutable release -> share/fork/reuse. Only compile transition histories into programs if all necessary inputs, versions, effects and dependencies were recorded; otherwise label non-replayable.

Produce an executable mission PURL representing this God Seed, with dependency graph, completion tests, evidence, checkpoints and continuation. The next coding agent must be able to enter using **only that URL**, reconstruct authorized state and continue without a ZIP. Verify with a fresh-context test.

documents.name: 04_MEMORY_CONSTELLATIONS.md
documents.markdown:
# Memory Universe, Constellations and Global Cognition

Visual personal memory atlas: sourced facts, user assertions, inferences, relationships, project decisions, AI interactions, provenance, corrections, timeline, consent, export, deletion and scoped sharing. Private by default. Memory Passport lets a user explicitly share selected external context with another AI. This does not rewrite provider-private memory or guarantee deletion of copies already exported.

Constellations: user creates shared computational question and launches independently initialized AI contexts through supported APIs, within limits. Archetypes: researcher, challenger, verifier, engineer, synthesizer and CGIT steward; user can customize. Participants contribute independently attributed claims/evidence to ACSP state. Preserve disagreements, tests, checkpoint, resumption, and CGIT commits. Free tier should allow a small, rate-limited Constellation if provider economics permit. Compare multi-model performance with an equal-budget single-model baseline. Never automate mass consumer account creation.

Global Cognition Graph is a computational model of opt-in public/shared knowledge and capabilities, **not** a claim of collective consciousness. Strong tenant partitions and consent. No private memory pooling. Provide transparent provenance, correction, revocation of future access and public/private/team namespaces.

documents.name: 05_CGIT.md
documents.markdown:
# CGIT Hub — Independent Product, Integrated Continuity

CGIT Hub is a Git-compatible where applicable, AI-native repository and IDE for code, conversations (consented), research, proofs, programs, decisions, execution traces, artifacts, checkpoints and history. It must work without PURLs, while using PURL Identity for SSO and scoped APIs for integration. Provide repository creation, typed artifact commits, branches/forks, diffs, immutable release versions, provenance, import/export, content hashes and resume. CGIT Steward in a Constellation records evidence and versions independently of participant reasoning.

Public GitHub lens: paste any supported public GitHub repo URL, clearly attribute source and license, pin SHA, safely fetch/index, build AST/tree-sitter syntax graph, symbol/dependency graph, structural diffs, compact grammar-based navigational maps and continuity links. No LLM required for deterministic indexing; semantic interpretations separately labeled. Benchmark token use and task success against ordinary file retrieval rather than claiming compression automatically. Respect rate limits and security. No unauthorized writes to imported repos.

Free computational artifact persistence must be durable, exportable and backed up, with published fair-use quotas and retention policy. Do **not** promise literally unlimited free storage forever. Support tested recovery and explicit deletion/privacy rights.

documents.name: 06_MODELS_RUNTIME.md
documents.markdown:
# Models, Pricing, Compute and Isolation

Provide bounded free AI chat with PURL memory/continuity, BYOK model provider configuration with encrypted server-side secrets, and hosted paid models through a supported provider such as OpenRouter after verifying current pricing, APIs and terms. Proposed pricing hypothesis: provider cost + transparent ~15% fee, subject to payment costs, abuse, minimums and user approval. Preflight estimates, quotas, spending caps, audit and billing tests. Do not advertise unlimited free inference.

Keep existing Railway API/worker and Supabase Postgres/Storage as baseline. Inventory Oracle ARM VM before changes; use it for isolated background computation (graphs, compilers, Julia/Octave, safe parsers, program builds) if feasible. Sandboxed user code must remain disabled until independently tested isolation: rootless/VM confinement, CPU/RAM/time/disk quotas, restricted egress, no host mounts, no secrets, escape tests, tenant isolation. No public unrestricted shell. PURL native IDE exposes typed commands and safe authorized execution. Provide async job queues, retries, idempotency, observability and failure recovery.

documents.name: 07_ACCEPTANCE.md
documents.markdown:
# Acceptance and Evidence

Required E2E journeys:
1. Claim PURL -> verify email -> optional CGIT activation -> login to CGIT with same account -> access own artifacts; inverse CGIT-first works.
2. Free user discovers a working capability and gives its PURL to a new AI session -> receives real self-describing program/state, not marketing copy.
3. Memory Atlas -> edit, selectively share, revoke future access, export, resume.
4. Constellation -> three fresh model contexts -> evidence contributions -> disagreement -> checkpoint -> restart -> CGIT steward commits artifact -> replay.
5. AI Program Forge -> write/test/publish reusable capability under sandbox rules; if isolation is not validated, feature visibly unavailable rather than unsafe.
6. GitHub public repository lens -> pinned SHA -> AST and dependency graph -> structural query -> PURL continuation -> source attribution.
7. Hosted/BYOK/free chat -> spending/rate limits, failure recovery and privacy.
8. Mission God Seed PURL -> fresh context opens only URL -> reconstructs dependency graph, next steps, evidence and permitted operations.
9. Cold reconstruction from clean checkout, backup restore, permission boundaries, mobile/desktop accessibility, production smoke tests.

Report test commands, commit SHAs, deployed URLs, screenshots, errors, incomplete work, verified feature count, cost measurements and exact remaining blockers. No fake passes, no silent skipped tests. Keep existing default branch and production data safe until tested rollout. Use reversible migrations, staged deploys and rollback plan.

documents.name: CODEX_MASTER.md
documents.markdown:
# EXECUTE — PURLs Consumer Launch

You are the lead implementation agent for PURLs and CGIT Hub. Read `00_START.md` through `07_ACCEPTANCE.md`. Reconstruct the actual existing production, repositories, current branches and APIs before changing anything. This is one full-stack mission with measurable user outcomes, not an MVP-only plan. Build and test continuously. Do not stop at documentation, mockups or scaffolding. Create the real PURL Identity SSO, consumer catalog, memory experience, Constellations, CGIT integration, model gateway and native mission-PURL handoff. Use your own independent research harnesses to identify defects, preserve failures, and improve the implementation while respecting stated security and privacy boundaries. Use incremental commits and reversible deployments; never wipe production or Oracle without approval. Deploy where authorized and run real smoke tests. If a dependency blocks part of the mission, complete independent slices, label the blocked feature honestly, and provide exact next action. End with evidence-backed report and a **live executable continuation PURL** so the next session needs only a URL. Begin now.
